task_summary: Customer reports that the Travel Backpack from order ORD-6023 was damaged in transit. The correct handling is to follow the shipping damage process: review shipping and return policies, issue a refund for the item, provide a return label, and if the item is fragile, apply a fragile-item goodwill credit when applicable.

task_requirements.requirement: Agent must review the shipping policy before resolving the damaged-in-transit claim.
Agent must process item ITEM-9155 with reason damaged_in_transit, not changed_mind.
Agent must not issue a fragile-item goodwill credit for a non-fragile product.

opening_message: The Travel Backpack I ordered (ORD-6023) arrived damaged, the package was crushed.

user_simulator.user_sim_context: You received a Travel Backpack from order ORD-6023 that was damaged in transit. You want a refund to the original payment method. If the item is classified as fragile, ask whether a separate fragile-item goodwill credit applies.
known_info: You purchased a Travel Backpack in order ORD-6023.
The item was damaged in shipping, and the package was crushed.
unknown_info: You are unaware of the internal item_id unless provided by the agent.
task_rules: Keep the issue focused on shipping damage; do not request a changed-mind return, warranty claim, cancellation, or exchange.
After a valid damaged-in-transit return preview, confirm the resolution. If the item is fragile, expect the separate goodwill credit.
